list.introductionEn: Against this backdrop, the International Contest on Aftershock Forecasting has been launched. The Contest aims to identify key scientific and technical challenges in earthquake-sequence forecasting, bring together expertise from around the world, encourage interdisciplinary collaboration, and promote innovation through emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and foundation models. Ultimately, it seeks to improve aftershock forecasting and strengthen global capacity for earthquake disaster response.
list.name: 余震预测技术国际大赛
list.introduction: 中国地震局地震预测研究所主办。本次比赛旨在梳理地震序列预测中的科技问题，汇集全球智慧，借助人工智能、大模型等新兴技术，推动学科交叉和合作，提升余震预测的准确性，并为地震序列后续强震的预测提供思路和参考，从而提升全球地震灾害应对能力。
